text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perubatan Tradisional dan

Komplementari (Penetapan Badan Pengamal) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa bagi tempoh dari 1 Ogos 2017

hingga 31 Julai 2019.

Penetapan badan pengamal

2. Menteri menetapkan badan pengamal yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual

sebagai badan pengamal ditetapkan bagi bidang amalan diiktiraf yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual bagi melaksanakan fungsi yang diwakilkan di bawah

subseksyen 17(1) Akta dan fungsi lain dalam Akta.

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE ACT 2016

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE

(DESIGNATION OF PRACTITIONER BODY) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 42(1) of the

Traditional and Complementary Medicine Act 2016 [Act 775], the Minister, on the

recommendation of the Council, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Traditional and Complementary Medicine

(Designation of Practitioner Body) Order 2017.

(2) This Order has effect for the period from 1 August 2017 to 31 July 2019.

Designation of practitioner bodies

2. The Minister designates practitioner bodies specified in column (1) of the

Schedule as the designated practitioner bodies of the recognized practice areas as

specified in column (2) of the Schedule to exercise the functions delegated under

subsection 17(1) of the Act and other functions under the Act.
